title: Spring Cleaning
author: Roger Carbol
description:
A down-on-his-luck commoner has been hired to clean the tower of the wizard Morkenmindan.

Spring Cleaning was written as part of Spring 'Speed' IF during the last week of March, 2008. I say 'speed' because this game took something like 10 hours to write, which is still pretty speedy, really, as far as these things go.

Dedicated to the memory of E. Gary Gygax.
